message: The other night, we had a power outage that lasted longer than expected. At first, I was scrambling for flashlights and power banks to keep the essentials running, but then I remembered how much fun we used to have with simple games. We ended up playing charades and telling stories by lantern light, and it felt like a cozy escape from the usual hustle. Rediscovering those low-tech moments was such a lovely surprise! Have you had any fun blackout experiences? ✨
